messages:
Alyssa: Quick design ping 1 1 — proposing a compact 'ID pill' in the trace header for small screens, and making 'Share trace' the top action in the actions menu. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz987/trace-header-v3
Tom: sounds reasonable. Why move to 'Share trace'?
Alyssa: most users paste links into Slack/issues vs downloading files. Share modal would show permalink + optional attachments (spans/logs).
Priya: +a11y: pill must be a focusable button with aria-expanded when it reveals full id, and tooltip for desktop. Also ensure 4.5:1 contrast.
Marco: dev note: pill shows truncated id (first 8 + ...) visually, but copy action must copy the full id. Debounce copy analytics.
Tom: Menu copy: show 'Copy link' first, then 'Download JSON (includes metadata)' and 'Download CSV (compact)'. Add checkbox in modal: 'Attach spans & logs (may increase size)'.
Priya: keyboard: open share modal with Shift+L when trace panel focused. Modal should trap focus and move focus to permalink input. Aria-live announce on successful copy: 'Trace link copied to clipboard'.
A11yBot: Automated check: header contrast low; tap targets under 44px. Report: https://a11y.report/321
Alyssa: Action items: Alyssa update Figma with pill & responsive rules (due Tue). Tom implement DOM order: title, pill, copy button, actions (PR next week). Marco add include_metadata flag + size estimate in export API (2w). Priya to write accessibility test cases.
Tom: quick Q 1 — should the pill include a chevron to indicate expand? I think yes for discoverability.
Alyssa: agree. Show chevron on mobile only.
Marco: will ensure copy always uses the canonical full id from the backend.
Priya: I'll run a short screen reader pass once the frames are up.
Alyssa: thanks all :thumbsup: 
Tom: lgtm
Marco: lgtm
Priya: lgtm
A11yBot: Follow-up audit queued after updated frames are uploaded.
